captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a bicycle power-meter crankset assembly. It features a central bottom-bracket shell with a single, black circular chainring that has a toothed outer edge and four spokes highlighted with orange accents. Two black, hollow-forged crank arms extend in opposite directions, each terminating in a rectangular clipless pedal with metallic silver spindle details. The crank assembly rotates continuously around its central axle, and each pedal is articulated to rotate continuously about its spindle while also tilting on a revolute float joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a bicycle power-meter crankset with a central bottom-bracket shell, a single spoked chainring with orange strain-gauge accents, and two opposing black crank arms. Attach rectangular clipless pedals to each arm, ensuring the entire crankset can rotate continuously and each pedal can rotate continuously and tilt.
captions.factory: The code constructs the assembly by first modeling a central bottom-bracket spindle and shell using cylindrical primitives. The chainring is created as a thin cylinder with a pattern of outer teeth subtracted or added, combined with four radial spokes containing orange-colored rectangular strain gauges. The two opposing crank arms are extruded profiles with rounded ends, positioned 180 degrees apart. Each pedal is modeled as a flat box with cylindrical spindles. Continuous joints are defined for the main crank rotation, the pedal spindles, and revolute joints for the pedal float tilt.
